description: For a given product, recommend the top complementary, frequently-bought-together products customers also bought, based on mined order-history association rules. This is the single-product cross-sell tool. Use this when the user asks 'what goes with X?', 'what should I bundle with X?', 'what do customers also buy with X?', 'recommend products to cross-sell with X', or similar single-product co-purchase questions. Works for all five platforms: Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, Magento, and OroCommerce.

limit.description: Maximum number of recommendations to return. Default 3, max 6.

product_id.description: Product id, either the numeric storefront id (e.g. '8472918765') or the platform-specific GID/SKU. Both are accepted.

name: get_recommendations
